name: Toaster-Oven Eggo Ice Cream Sandwich
whyItWorks: Crispy, warm, and cold all at once with almost no fiber (~0.5g-1g).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast two plain or blueberry Eggo waffles in the toaster oven until crisp, sandwich a scoop of lactose-free vanilla ice cream between them, and eat immediately.
